tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Dinstar C60U Entry-Level IP Phone with PoE and Adapter – Reliable, Cost-Effective Business Communication Solution

The Dinstar C60U Entry-Level IP Phone with PoE (Power over Ethernet) and an included adapter is the perfect solution for businesses looking for a high-quality, budget-friendly VoIP phone. Designed for seamless communication, this phone offers outstanding call clarity, user-friendly features, and easy installation, making it ideal for small to medium-sized businesses.

Key Features:

  • Power over Ethernet (PoE): Simplifies installation by providing power and data over a single Ethernet cable.
  • Crystal-Clear Audio: Experience high-definition voice quality for clear and professional communication.
  • Multiple SIP Accounts: Supports multiple SIP accounts for efficient call management and flexibility.
  • User-Friendly Interface: A sleek, easy-to-navigate interface with a large LCD screen for quick access to key features.
  • Complete with Adapter: Includes a power adapter for additional flexibility in installation, perfect for environments where PoE may not be available.
  • Cost-Effective: Offers a budget-friendly solution for businesses looking for reliable VoIP communication without compromising on quality.
  • Programmable Keys: Customizable keys for quick access to frequently used functions, enhancing workflow efficiency.
  • Quick Setup: Easy configuration and automatic provisioning, compatible with various SIP-based platforms.


The Dinstar C60U Entry-Level IP Phone is an ideal choice for businesses seeking a reliable, easy-to-use, and affordable VoIP phone with PoE support and an included adapter. Improve your business communication with this efficient and scalable solution.
